Desert without enough_horses (act6.gd counts: horses alive + keeper_horses + horses lent by surviving rivals >= party size + 1) can still be picked: risk Severe, and act6.gd ends it with the mummy catching you (event desert_return). title: The race back to Cairo
intro: The thieves are ahead. The mummy is behind.

options.label: Across the desert
options.desc: The fastest way back, if there is a horse for everyone. Without enough of them, the mummy catches you in the open.

options.label: Along the coast
options.desc: Slower, but the trucks (if any still run) and the animals the other expeditions spare can carry everyone. Without a truck it takes a day longer. The mummy gains on Cairo every extra day.

options.label: The river
options.desc: There are no riverboats left for your expedition.
